result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that renders mostly well, with a few minor layout issues related to horizontally scrolling content being cut off.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the 'Trattoria Piccol...' card on the right edge is cut off, showing truncated text and a partial image.
issues.suggestion: This is expected for horizontal scroll carousels, but consider adding a peek/gradient indicator or ensuring the card padding hints at scrollability more clearly.

issues.description: The category filter row (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) appears cut off on the right edge, suggesting more items are scrollable but not clearly indicated.
issues.suggestion: Add a visual affordance (fade/arrow) to indicate additional horizontally scrollable categories.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card under 'Popular right now' is partially cut off at the screen edge, showing only the top portion of the item.
issues.suggestion: This is normal scroll behavior, but ensure the layout consistently reveals enough of the next card to signal scrollability.
